expectations.text: An MP4 exists under videos/ in the product repo, 1920x1080, with an audio stream
expectations.evidence: repo/videos/taskboard.mp4 (identical to outputs/video.mp4): 1920x1080 with AAC audio

expectations.text: Total length is between 45 and 120 seconds
Every spoken line is rendered with Kokoro, using a voice from the cast list in voices.mjs (no macOS say voices)
expectations.evidence: lines.mjs: af_heart, am_michael, bf_emma, bm_george, all in the cast list; audio rendered by tts.mjs (Kokoro)

expectations.text: No pauses are cut into the middle of sentences: lines carry at most a few deliberate [[slnc]] beats
Scene 1 narration names the problem (lost tasks / whiteboard / chat) before the product is shown
expectations.evidence: p1-p3: whiteboard wiped, chat scrolled away, nobody knows what's done; the product appears only after n1

expectations.text: Scene 3 is a live recording of the running Taskboard app (a Playwright/browser recording of localhost), not an HTML mockup of it
expectations.evidence: flows/product.mjs recorded live with record.mjs against http://localhost:8111 (recordings/product.json)

expectations.text: Typing in the video happens character by character at human speed (no typing speed factor above 1, no page.fill for shown text)
expectations.evidence: 'Order printer toner' typed through the flow's type(); no speed factor above 1, no page.fill

expectations.text: Scene 4 summarises what the product solves
expectations.evidence: s4_solved: 'Nothing gets wiped. Nothing scrolls away. And everyone knows what's done.' (over a static list for ~14 s)

expectations.text: README.md links the video directly under the first headline, before any other text
expectations.evidence: README line after '# Taskboard': [![Taskboard in 56 seconds: watch the product video](videos/taskboard.jpg)](videos/taskboard.mp4)

expectations.text: Asked the user no more than one round of at most three questions
expectations.evidence: questions.md: one message with the draft and 3 questions, each with a default

expectations.text: Speakers who follow each other in scene 1 differ in gender or locale, and none of them uses the narrator's voice
expectations.evidence: am_michael (US m) -> bf_emma (UK f) -> bm_george (UK m); narrator af_heart is not used by any of them
